changes: First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: hold QPER and turn a knob to lock the linked performance; QPER + YES writes what you hear into the kit; QPER + PLAY clears, RECORD and STOP copy and paste.
In LIVE RECORDING, performance moves from the pads, the QPER knob and MIDI are kept in a quick perf rec that loops with the pattern, 8 points a step, and plays back through the performances.
RECORD + YES writes the quick perf rec into the pattern as locks, and RECORD + NO clears it (NO again undoes), in any recording mode.
Tracks shorter than the take are lengthened to fit, with their trig conditions rewritten so they play on the same passes.
The quick perf rec lives in RAM: a pattern change or power off drops a take you have not applied. It loops every 64 steps at most.
